appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Product Rating Share by Category'.
Vertical axis labeled 'Value', with numeric ticks from 0 to 55 in increments of 5.
Horizontal axis labeled 'Category', with tick marks for: 'Quality', 'Price', 'Design', 'Support', 'Delivery', 'Other'.
Blue circular data point at 'Quality' labeled '36%'.
Blue circular data point at 'Price' labeled '38%'.
Blue circular data point at 'Design' labeled '34%'.
Blue circular data point at 'Support' labeled '45%'.
Blue circular data point at 'Delivery' labeled '43%'.

public_definitions: Review the Product Rating Share dashboard, then assign additional promotional budget to the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
Use the dashboard labeled rating-share values as the evidence source; the promotion budget is reserved for the category with the strongest current rating-share signal.
Select the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
